theme.vibe: Professional, Grounded, and Trustworthy Nutrition ERP
theme.mode: Light theme default (best for data clarity in ERPs)

typography.instructions: Import 'Sansation' font. Ensure it's applied globally to override the existing Chivo/IBM Plex fonts. Add to Tailwind config as the default sans font.

layouts.dashboard_grid: High Density Grid (Mode B): Use grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4 with gap-4 or gap-6. Keep every pixel utilized.
layouts.sidebar: Collapsible sidebar. Use a very deep forest green (#0f1f17) for the sidebar background with white/light green text for high contrast. Active states should have a subtle dark green background (#1B4D3E).
layouts.tables: Cardless or flat solid surface. No heavy shadow. 1px solid border (#e5e7eb). Left align tabular text, right align financial figures.
layouts.forms: Use Shadcn components heavily customized. Flat rectangular inputs, crisp 1px borders. No native HTML inputs.

surfaces.cards: Flat solid surfaces with max 8px border-radius (rounded-lg). Use 1px subtle border. No muddy transparent backgrounds.
surfaces.header: Solid background (white) with hard bottom 1px border. DO NOT use transparent backgrounds over content.

motion.hover_states: -translate-y-1 with subtle shadow-md for interactive cards. Smooth scale up for buttons.
motion.buttons: Explicitly set hover text color. Example: hover:bg-[#143a2e] hover:text-white. No universal 'transition-all'.

component_instructions.buttons: Slightly rounded (rounded-md). Use primary forest green (#1B4D3E) for primary actions ONLY. Secondary buttons should be outline with forest green text.
component_instructions.charts: Recharts or Shadcn charts. Use monochromatic green scales (e.g., #a7f3d0, #34d399, #1B4D3E) for revenue/advertising charts.
component_instructions.badges: For batch alerts and expiry statuses: High contrast backgrounds. E.g., warning_bg for expiring soon, danger_bg for expired.

instructions_to_main_agent: Update tailwind.config.js to include Sansation as the primary sans font.
Refactor Dashboard.jsx KPIs to use the high-density bento grid.
Refactor Layout.jsx to have a solid deep green sidebar and a clean white top header with bottom border.
Refactor Login.jsx to use the forest green nature texture image as the split screen hero.
Update all forms and tables in Master Data, Sales, Finance, etc., to use flat solid styles with 1px borders.
Do NOT add new features. Focus entirely on applying this aesthetic refresh based on these guidelines.

image_urls.description: Lush forest green leaf texture for the login page split-screen background to reinforce the GreenPeak brand.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure all text meets minimum 4.5:1 contrast against background.
accessibility.testing: All interactive elements MUST include a data-testid attribute in kebab-case format.

UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic outputs. Create creative, distinctive frontends.
DO NOT use complete transparent background in header, overlays, or any surface that has content under it.
Do not make generic centered layouts. DO NOT add .App { text-align: center; }.
You MUST NOT apply universal transition (e.g., transition: all). Add specific transitions.
All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a `data-testid` attribute for robust automated testing.
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters (🤖🧠) for icons. Use Phosphor or Lucide icons.
